content: अनुकर्षः, -र्षणम् .²1 Dragging after, drawing along; attraction in general. .²2 Summoning or invoking (by means of spells). .²3 Grammatical attraction, application or attraction of a word in a preceding rule to a subsequent rule, word <ab>&c.</ab>; नायमनुकर्षणार्थश्चकारः <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. II. 2. 4</ls>; see also <ls>Sk.</ls> on <ls>P. VI. 1. 127</ls>. .²4 [अनुकृष्यते स्वसम्बद्धेन चक्रेण] The axle-tree or bottom of a carriage. .²5 Delayed performance of a duty.
